mapper.sql: cd.company_document_id AS companyDocumentId, cd.category AS category, cd.name AS name, lv.company_document_version_id AS latestVersionId, lv.version_no AS latestVersionNo, vc.cnt AS versionCount, lv.original_file_name AS originalFileName, lv.extension AS extension, lv.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, lv.uploader_name AS uploaderName, lv.uploader_department AS uploaderDepartment, lv.uploader_position AS uploaderPosition, lv.completed_at AS updatedAt

FROM company_document cd JOIN (
SELECT v.company_document_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(v.version_no) AS mx FROM company_document_version v JOIN company_document cdj ON cdj.company_document_id = v.company_document_id AND cdj.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE v.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY v.company_document_id ) vc ON vc.company_document_id = cd.company_document_id JOIN company_document_version lv ON lv.company_document_id = cd.company_document_id AND lv.version_no = vc.mx AND lv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND lv.deleted_at IS NULL

sql.if: AND (cd.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR lv.original_file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*)
WHERE cd.company_id = #{companyId} AND cd.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT company_document_version_id AS versionId, version_no AS versionNo, original_file_name AS originalFileName, extension AS extension, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, page_count AS pageCount, comment AS comment, uploader_name AS uploaderName, uploader_department AS uploaderDepartment, uploader_position AS uploaderPosition, completed_at AS completedAt FROM company_document_version WHERE company_document_id = #{companyDocumentId} AND upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY version_no DESC
